defects.first_divergence: COMPLETION regex group /כבר\s+(שלחתי|התקשרתי|חייגתי|שלחת)/ included 2nd-person 'שלחת' ('YOU sent'); the monitor exists to catch the ASSISTANT falsely claiming IT (1st person) completed an action.
defects.reproduction: detectForbiddenCompletion('כבר שלחת לו את זה?') returned a violation -> assistant question wrongly triggers 'fabricated_completion' repair.
defects.fix: Removed 2nd-person 'שלחת' from the group and wrapped the group in the 'לא ' negation guard; only 1st-person completions count.
defects.regression_test: src/screens/AbuAI/realtime/truthMonitor.test.ts :: 'forward-Hebrew false positive: a 2nd-person question is NOT a 1st-person completion'

defects.regression_test: src/screens/AbuAI/realtime/truthMonitor.test.ts :: 'forward-Hebrew false positive: negated "דיברתי עם" is truthful, never flagged'
